entities.name: 1989 Belgium MiG-23 crash
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On July 4, 1989, a pilotless MiG-23M Flogger-B jet fighter of the Soviet Air Forces crashed into a house in Bellegem, near Kortrijk, Belgium, killing one person. The pilot had ejected over an hour earlier near Kołobrzeg, Poland, after experiencing technical problems, but the aircraft continued flying for around 900 km (600 mi) before running out of fuel and crashing into the ground.
